$Comment: The in-game screen for the diminishing keys, on the owner menu (/zigadmin): one row per key a track source's Diminish may name (Cell16, Position, Target, Station, Victim, and any a pack ships), each opening what it counts each moment per, saved straight into mods/ziggfreedcommon/diminish-keys.json under that key's id, beside the value it has without your file. An owner may add a key of their own by a new id and remove one only their file holds. Every word is a key of ziggfreedcommon.track.lang. Retune this screen (its place on the menu, a bound) in mods/ziggfreedcommon/owner-forms.json under the id Diminish_Keys.
Title: ziggfreedcommon.track.form.keys.title
